## About the role

Kelp is hiring Data Analyst Freshers in Mumbai. Kelp provides investment teams with technology and analytical support to improve performance and create value. Its Kelp Pulse platform combines AI with expert analysts to help clients research companies across industries and turn raw data into actionable intelligence.

### Responsibilities

- Work hands-on with data, research, and AI tools.
- Contribute directly to client projects.
- Take ownership of assigned work and grow with a fast-moving team.

### Requirements

- Freshers interested in starting a career in Data and AI.
- Curious, proactive, and detail-oriented approach.
- Willingness to learn and make an impact.
